question: A semicircular arc of wire of radius $R = 10$ cm carries a current $I = 5$ A. It is placed in a uniform magnetic field $B = 0.5$ T perpendicular to the plane of the semicircle. The current enters and leaves the arc through connecting leads that are along the direction of $\vec{B}$ (so the force on the leads is zero). Calculate the magnitude of the magnetic force acting on the semicircular arc.
